newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Jasatera falls on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Jasatera falls on requotation.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian construction and real estate company Jasatera Bhd fell on requotation after announcing it has a new major shareholder.
Around 0210 GMT, the stock was down 1.40 ringgit to 22.60 with 1.017 million shares traded. The stock was suspended on Wednesday pending the news announcement.
Jasatera said on Thursday that Korakyat Corp Sdn Bhd had become a substantial shareholder with a 25 percent equity interest in it by buying 4.8 million shares in the open market.
Korakyat is developer of the Electric Vehicular Industrial Park in eastern Terengganu state.
It has awarded a 293 million ringgit contract for first phase development of the park to Jasatera.
